decision: The owner ordered a build and publication to all channels without long full testing and without UI runs (those move to the next release). Told that release.yml requires a playback smoke verdict, a code-audit verdict and the CI test suite, and that a release once shipped a player that played nothing while its tests were green, the owner chose to waive all checks.
notRun: the code-audit campaign of docs/agent/CODE_AUDIT.md (97 audited files changed since the 26.1117.1838 audit)
installation of the self-signed MSIX and of the setup EXE
